label: Services
description: Registers framework and configured services, resolves singleton, scoped, and transient instances lazily, explicitly initializes cached services, creates hierarchical resource-ownership scopes, validates declared contract surfaces, and exposes service metadata.

registry.description: Frozen snapshot of application registration metadata. Scoped and transient entries report registration-level state and do not expose scope caches, service instances, or implementation classes.

lifetime.description: Explicit configured lifetime. Programmatic preconstructed registrations report singleton.

tags.description: Frozen tag identifiers from the registered public contract, in declaration order.

beginScope.description: Creates an active child Services instance that shares root registrations and singletons while owning an independent resource lifecycle and optional construction context.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Optional scope settings. context is an owner-specific object exposed only to scoped and transient constructors as scopeContext.

returns.description: A new child Services instance whose direct parent is the Services instance that created it.

addDisposable.description: Registers a resource for once-only reverse-order disposal by this Services instance. The resource must expose a callable dispose method and is not registered as a service.

parameters.name: resource
parameters.description: Scope-owned resource exposing a synchronous or asynchronous dispose() method.

dispose.description: Disposes child scopes and directly owned resources in reverse order. Concurrent calls share the same asynchronous cleanup operation, which reports cleanup failures after all resources have been attempted.

returns.description: Promise that settles when hierarchical cleanup has completed.

has.description: Checks whether a service name is registered without creating its instance.

resolve.description: Synchronously resolves by configured lifetime: a root-owned singleton, one cached instance per explicit child scope, or a new transient. Construction uses the owning Services context for dependencies and throws for missing services, circular dependencies, invalid captive dependencies, or root resolution of a scoped service.

parameters.name: consumer
parameters.description: Identifies the immediate consumer for a service that supports consumer adaptation. Lifetime ownership is independent of this identity.

returns.description: Service instance, its adapted representation when a consumer is supplied and the service has an internal hook, or null if registered without an implementation or instance.

initialize.description: Resolves and explicitly initializes a singleton once per application or a scoped service once per owning scope. Concurrent callers for the same owned instance share one operation and failures are retained. Transient services cannot be initialized by registration name.

returns.description: Promise resolving to the initialized singleton or scoped service instance.

getServiceInfo.description: Returns a frozen projection of application registration metadata, including effective lifetime, without exposing instances or scope-local caches.

returns.description: Service metadata object with id, lifetime, registration-level construction and initialization state, contractId, contractUrl, description, icon, tags, moduleId, implementationName, url, size, and time; undefined if not found.
